events.title: GDG Brisbane Monthly Meetup - June Edition!
events.description: This meetup features two talks: "OWASP LLM & Agentic AI Security" by Benjamin Luck and "Friday Idea, Sunday Cheers to Monday Launch" by Dilum De Silva. It includes free food, drinks, and networking, attracting intellectually engaged individuals interested in AI and tech.

events.title: ON THE WILD SIDE: Filming Creatures Great and Small Presented by Pieter de Vries
events.location: Auditorium 1, The State Library of Queensland, South Brisbane
events.description: Filmmaker Pieter de Vries shares stories and techniques from his nature documentaries for David Attenborough and National Geographic, featuring segments from his work. This lecture offers insights into science and nature filmmaking.

events.title: Brisbane Philosophy Café
events.description: A recurring community meetup providing a free and friendly space for people to gather and discuss philosophical ideas in an open format. It's an excellent opportunity for natural conversation among intellectually engaged people.

events.title: AI & Society | Run Walk Coffee Club
events.description: A social running, walking, and coffee club organized by the "AI & Society — Global" Meetup group. This event combines outdoor activity with discussions on AI and societal topics among intellectually curious individuals.

events.title: Artist in Residence: Martin Edge – Museum of Brisbane
events.description: Visitors can watch Queensland artist Martin Edge create a large-scale mural directly on the gallery walls, chat with him about his process, and experience his vibrant, whimsical compositions inspired by Brisbane life.

events.title: "Where do I belong? Our birds through art" Exhibition
events.description: An art exhibition focused on birds, likely exploring themes of belonging and nature through artistic expression. This ongoing exhibition offers visual art for reflection.

events.title: Marion Hughes Watercolour Class/Event
events.description: An opportunity to engage with watercolour painting, led by artist Marion Hughes. This is a hands-on creative workshop to learn artistic techniques.

events.title: Artist Market at Obsidian
events.description: A market featuring original art and creative goods directly from local makers, offering an opportunity to engage with artists and support the creative community.

events.title: Franck Gohier | 'Australia Has Cowboys Too' (Exhibition)
events.description: An art exhibition showcasing the vibrant work of Franck Gohier, offering artistic value and cultural exploration through his unique perspective on Australian identity.

events.title: Mandy Quadrio: Kukunna Wurraweena (Exhibition)
events.description: An exhibition by Trawlwoolway Tasmanian Aboriginal artist Mandy Quadrio, featuring womblike sculptures and moving-image work that explore themes of silence and connection to the past, offering artistic and cultural stimulation.

events.title: Erika Scott: Cambium Itch (Exhibition)
events.description: An exhibition by Erika Scott featuring maximalist sculptures made from everyday detritus, transforming objects into a supersized 'pin-art toy' installation. This engages with themes of design, creativity, and re-purposing materials.

events.title: Cartoon Violence: Takeshi Murata and Bunny Rogers (Exhibition)
events.description: This exhibition features two 3D animations by Takeshi Murata and Bunny Rogers, critically grappling with coded, gendered violence in American cartoons, offering an intellectually stimulating perspective on culture and human behavior.

events.title: World Press Photo Exhibition 2026
events.description: A powerful and thought-provoking selection of the world's best photojournalism, offering insights into global events, human behavior, and culture through visual storytelling.

events.title: Brisbane Art and Craft 2026
events.location: Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre, South Brisbane
events.description: A vibrant vendor event showcasing original art, handmade crafts, jewelry, and more. It features live art demonstrations and interactive craft activities, fostering creative community engagement in a family-friendly atmosphere.

events.title: The Great Clay Throw: A pottery experience
events.description: An opportunity to try the pottery wheel, offering a hands-on creative experience for participants interested in craft and ceramics.
